notes.title: March 2025 Update - Trailer & Modes Overview!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/59770769ab289361111794199201d10bb4b9bd4b.png[/img]

First, check out this new trailer: 

https://youtu.be/vtxiPu7Cr8Q

Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you!  The entirety of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

[b]Cypress Reel
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/9677a909a75b28e637ceb34b3a4f178b0716e163.png[/img]

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes!  You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more!  Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!

[b]Story mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/8512ba1729ba7b2e84ea19f68d7346be4a2cc8b3.jpg[/img]

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting!  Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters.  Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.

[b]Invasion mode
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/2170722194b67491d86f8398c70ef68f36ced3bf.jpg[/img]

A different flavor of survival.  You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents.  Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more.  Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle.  Multiple maps will be available!

[b]Raid mode
[/b]

This arcade-style experience is a blast.  Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out!  As with the rest of [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b], Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time.  Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.

[b]Mini-games
[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/7d7475934f99c250afa98975b54c30484bbe6e13.jpg[/img]

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces.  From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over.  Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b] begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year!  We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues.  Thank you as always for your support and patience.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 3 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/84af881a4de8ca531fad3bc7918e0214d96de8c4.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

[h1]Patch 3[/h1]
- Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1ad558ba52773cb53b86bf159aa488a7e6dce9af.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors!

Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!

Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!

[h1]Patch 2[/h1]
- Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
- Added the Update Notes screen.
- High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
- Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
- Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
- Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
- Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
- Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
- Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

Outbreak: Endless Nightmares twists the series' survival horror gameplay by adding elements of roguelike gameplay. You'll need to explore, hunt for supplies, uncover clues, and fight your way through each anomaly – each consisting of semi-procedurally generated instances where both the environment, and the undead, are out to kill you!

Immediately after the events of Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles, you find yourself trapped within the remains of Arzt Memorial Hospital – the hub to organize your inventory and storage cache, level up your character, or just to take a breather before venturing back out into the chaos. There’s more to discover in the world besides murderous hordes of the undead – find the journals scattered about to learn more about the outbreak and ultimately where to find refuge! Don’t think death can save you – every time you die, you'll awake trapped in this nexus.

Outbreak: Endless Nightmares focuses on extreme replayability by offering multiple character options – each with their own abilities, upgrade paths and more! Each time you venture into the anomaly, it’ll change and become increasingly difficult as you grow in power. You'll need to think carefully about what weapons, healing items, and other supplies you'll bring along. If you're lucky, you may find storage caches that give you access to your expanded inventory, and offer an opportunity to restock. But it's all on you to search your environment for supplies. If you run out ... your fate is sealed!

[*][b]Three Camera Angles:[/b] Choose a view that works for you – Fixed camera, over the shoulder, or first person. 
[*][b]Photo Mode:[/b] Take beautiful pictures with the camera or use the photo mode to scan or anything dangerous nearby!
[*][b]Death Isn’t the End:[/b] Death returns you to the hub with most of your inventory intact, experience, and money.
[*][b]Semi-Procedurally Generated Dungeons:[/b] Revisit anomaly dungeons multiple times to find different traps, enemies, puzzles, challenges – and loot! 
[*][b]Co-Op:[/b] Fight the nightmare with a friend in 2-player Split-Screen Co-Op.
[*][b]Character Options:[/b] Choose from 6 unique characters, each with their own backstory, stats, and ability loadouts.
[*][b]Crafting:[/b] Dismantle, repair, and upgrade weapons; build ammo through gunpowder; and combine healing items to create new formulas and more!
[*][b]Game Modes:[/b] Choose from 5 gameplay modes – Standard, Ironman, Randomizer, Lost Hope, and Easy Mode.
[*][b]Uncover the Story: [/b]Search through notes and logs to read more from Lydia’s journal and piece together the past and future of the outbreak.

notes.title: Local Co-op is coming to Outbreak: Epidemic!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

Fast off the heels of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/644480/view/2245554624205641165]Outbreak: The New Nightmare getting local co-op[/url], we're happy to announce it's coming to Outbreak: Epidemic as well! You will be able to play the entire game in 2-player splitscreen co-op. This will be coming to Steam first and then consoles later in 2020!

[h1]Local Co-op Overview[/h1]

You'll access splitscreen co-op through the new Local Game menu (replacing the Single-player menu).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/7795ec056534d3f38a5a901fc7d0be901d6584c5.jpg[/img]
Once there, you can either set up a solo or local co-op game by selecting your characters for each player. If P2 is set to None, you'll play solo. If you set a character, you'll enter local co-op when the game starts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/07f6b116c48a13d25e41bc71d9d0dd1cb38bdf23.jpg[/img]
Both players will be able to select their characters and fully level them up during gameplay. All characters are pulled from the owner's Steam profile. Everyone shares EXP, so each player will get equal XP as you fight through the scenarios. All game modes and scenarios are supported in local co-op.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/11306c81d1c751cce2a9cdc72498e438d09020e4.jpg[/img]
You can customize controls for each player in the Options -> Controls menu. Either player can use Keyboard, mouse or gamepad and all controls can be rebinded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/a8044eb94832ea545edebeff9fb0057cc512725a.jpg[/img]
You can also see the current stats and EXP of each player via the Options menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/3a881e3fe642e76a98da96f58552a8e482c44579.jpg[/img]
Unfortunately, due to current limitations, only one inventory screen can be up at the same time. BUT you can still use the hotkeys to quickly equip your different weapons without going into the inventory and interrupting gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/cb3613ef0731fc6b21610474d187fabb7f1eb1c1.png[/img]
Stay tuned for details on when this patch will be going live. As with Outbreak: The New Nightmare, local co-op is experimental and you may encounter bugs or other issues. You can expect patches for both titles in the near future as the experience is refined.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/a9b852c596ee31fbc8867f767d5f45f72891419e.jpg[/img]
Thanks for playing the Outbreak series. The best is still yet to come!

notes.title: Outbreak: Epidemic Major Content Update Coming Feb 12th, 2020!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

We're happy to announce that Outbreak: Epidemic will leave Steam Early Access on Feb 12th, 2020 with the release of a brand new major content update! It will also release on Xbox One at the same time.

[h1]What can we expect in the update?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/cb524ae0b98d9153d8788a93ae55d3569c722a58.jpg[/img]
You'll be fighting across six brand new scenarios in two new locations, the Tunnels and the Streets. After their harrowing escape from the underground morgue and repairing the train, the survivors find themselves trapped in the city's subway system. You'll need to blast your way up to the street-level if you want to escape. Then on the streets, the survivors will be confronted by both defusing a nuclear bomb and repairing their means of escape.

This update will bring Outbreak: Epidemic up to 18 total scenarios across the Campaign, Onslaught and Experiments modes. In addition, numerous gameplay fixes, tweaks and minor enhancements are included based on the months of testing the game has gone through. It's going to be a massive expansion to the series.

[h1]Why leave Early Access now?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/170c5456c351ab58bd4b25b59fce1ef09ba191d1.jpg[/img]
Outbreak: Epidemic will have reached a point with this update that it is fully functional and playable from start to finish. The majority of major bugs have been eliminated and the game plays great in both single-player and up to 4-player co-op. In addition, you have 18 scenarios to fight across (fully in co-op if you choose!). It makes sense to bring the game to a larger audience now.

[h1]But is this the end of development for the game?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224426/071a1424a82c8d07db70a945f754778b1365a46a.jpg[/img]
Of course not! Like all other titles in the Outbreak series, this title will continue to get new content. I'll be looking for the players to suggest in the discussion boards what they'd like to see more of: features, weapons, scenarios or fixes! Your feedback will directly drive where the game goes from here! So grab some friends, get some playtime in and send me your feedback on the forums!

Stay tuned for more information leading up to the release, including details on the Deluxe Edition DLC! Thank you for playing Epidemic and the entire Outbreak series. The best is yet to come!

[h1]New Location - The Depths[/h1]
After the survivors desperate attempt to call for help at the end of the Outbreak Scenario, they eventually learn that there's a military camp situated in a nearby urban center. With the undead roaming the countryside and a lack of a working vehicle, they take to the underground tunnels to try to find a way into the subway system underneath the city.

This leads them into the Depths, a dark and desolated underground system where they will learn horrifying truths about how the government tried to mitigate the epidemic.

On August 9th, you'll have access to a brand new Campaign scenario, two new Onslaught scenarios, and a new Experiments scenario. The campaign will take the survivors on a desperate quest to repair part of the underground subway system to make their way further into the city.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35224426/9cee84554d6ff47de414789fc24c21cee2578464.png[/img]
The new Experiments scenario increases the intensity by giving you 30 minutes to navigate the underground caverns to retrieve a desperately needed item before you make your escape. This guns blazing scenario will force you to move quickly, and carefully determine when you want to stop at a supply drop (scattered throughout the scenario) to re-arm. Be careful though, if you take too long, the caves will fill with gas and you'll be dead quickly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35224426/1f059dc1c7a01a19bc1d2157cbe67d33b6ebd7ae.jpg[/img]
[h1]Patch v3.0[/h1]
This release on August 9th will come with Patch v3.0, which includes a large amount of small fixes and polish across the entire game (too much to list). It will also include heavily requested options like the ability to toggle your flashlight on or off during gameplay.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35224426/8a4410f115d1e478e28d2b44f87dc33914faafea.png[/img]
[h1]Transitioning from Free To Play to a Traditional Paid Title on August 9th[/h1]
I'm also ready to announce that Outbreak: Epidemic will be transitioning from a F2P title with optional premium content to a more traditional paid title like all of the other games in the Outbreak series. When I was planning to launch Epidemic, my goal was to open it to a larger community and invite everyone to play what was essentially a demo, with the option to upgrade to the full version.

After gathering feedback and observing the game's progress over the last month, it was determined that this model ultimately wouldn't allow the development of the game to proceed at the rate I want in the F2P model. It became clear that I would need to go in a route of creating and marketing add-on content like cosmetics to ensure the game remains financially viable, and that effort (with only a single developer working on the game) would greatly interfere with the development roadmap and timelines.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35224426/27a465774edb6d10617dd74c4ea06511cc20cace.png[/img]
Transitioning to a paid title will allow me to focus on developing the core game experience including new scenarios, while not needing to focus on cosmetic or add-on content too early in the development process. It's definitely understandable if some folks will be unhappy with this decision, but I hope you'll understand that it's the best for the game long-term so it can stay on track and new content can be delivered at a reasonable clip.

[b]To be clear - there are no plans to transition back to a F2P title for this game. It ultimately makes more sense as a more classical paid title.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35224426/791074039b66d7f303c2fd5068e5f2fd5844e020.png[/img]
[h1]So how will the title work when the patch is released on August 9th?[/h1]
For people who have purchased the [b]Premium Content[/b] DLC, you will [b]get access to the full paid game (as you've already paid for the upgrade)[/b]. For anyone who has not upgraded to the Premium Content DLC and is only on the F2P version, unfortunately they will lose access to the title unless they purchase it. After speaking with Valve, this seemed like the best compromise for the title to ensure folks who have invested their money in the title get full access and their purchase remains valid.

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thank you to the entire community for supporting the Outbreak series and sharing such passionate feedback about the game. Epidemic has grown by leaps and bounds in the month since it launched and there's plenty of exciting new locations, content and more on the horizon. Thank you! :outbreakzombie:

notes.title: Getting Started with Epidemic
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35224426/ba61ae8beffba26161a8b3801116a406f57e82b0.jpg[/img]
Welcome to Outbreak: Epidemic. The first time you load up Epidemic's F2P version (without the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104420/Outbreak_Epidemic__Premium_Content/]Premium Content DLC[/url] installed), you'll be faced with a tremendously difficult decision. You'll need to pick your survivor - a permanent choice that you'll need to live with as long as you stick to the F2P version of the game. The survivor you pick in the F2P version will only have access to their starting class and can only level up to Level 4.

[b]Note:[/b] You can unlock access to ALL characters, classes and the ability to start games on Biohazard or Nightmare difficulty by purchasing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104420/Outbreak_Epidemic__Premium_Content/]Premium Content DLC[/url].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35224426/3b765943eab3d6aebbb8597296ad75a1f1d364fe.jpg[/img]
It is highly recommended that you take a minute to visit the "Characters & Upgrades" screen before making this selection. You can view all of the character classes there and their starting stats. Your choices on the main menu are:
[list]
[*] Gwen - Survivor Class
[*] Tom - Marksman Class
[*] Kara - Reporter Class
[*] Renault - Renegade Class
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35224426/5e34ee9f64a0b2da09b5232efaf46d67cbc65d6b.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's the difference between the F2P version and the Premium Content?[/h1]
In a nutshell, the F2P version allows you to play on ANY game mode or scenario either alone or with up to three additional friends. The limitations in this version is that you are forced to select a single survivor and you can only level up to level 4. You also cannot start games on the Biohazard or Nightmare difficulty BUT you can join other games hosted by users on those difficulties. Essentially in the F2P version - you can always play with your friends - no matter if they're on F2P or have the Premium Content installed.

[h1]Why did you choose to restrict these portions of the game in the F2P version?[/h1]
Restricting the characters, classes and higher difficulties options, but allowing you to play on any game mode, scenario or join all games was designed to ensure that everyone has plenty of content to play and to help grow the player population. For folks who enjoy the game and experience, they can choose to upgrading using the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104420/Outbreak_Epidemic__Premium_Content/]Premium Content DLC[/url] and gain full access to all characters, their classes, the ability to level up to level 10 and start games on Biohazard or Nightmare difficulty.

[h1]What can I expect as the game continues to develop in Early Access?[/h1]
You can expect more scenarios for Campaign, Onslaught and Experiments modes. New enemies, weapons, items and more. Polish to the entire game experience will continue, including gameplay tweaks, performance enhancements, etc... And best of all, we want YOUR feedback to determine how to prioritize this work and what you'd like to see added. Feel free to sound off on our Discussion Boards!

Have fun and make sure to tell your friends! We're looking forward to surviving and growing this game experience with you in the year to come!

notes.title: Outbreak: Epidemic launches July 9th on Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1082220/ss_2c2ecb7cc2c773c4690fe0539e8c00b37ca4efc9.jpg[/img]
Outbreak: Epidemic launches on Steam Early Access on July 9th, 2019! Check out the brand new trailer and screenshots on the store page!

Return to the world of co-op survival horror in our brand new F2P adventure. On July 9th, you'll be able to play content across the Campaign Mode, Onslaught Mode and Experiments Mode with your friends FOR FREE. When you begin your adventure, you'll choose a survivor and be able to jump right into single-player or co-op.

If you decide you want to expand your experience, you can buy the Premium Content DLC for complete access to all survivors, difficulty levels and the ability to level them up past level 4.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35224426/62a3b351ce6bf7597d7e579dd11502082139794e.jpg[/img]
[h1]Early Access?[/h1]
Outbreak: Epidemic will launch with a healthy amount of content, but it's just the beginning. Over the next year, additional scenarios, weapons, gameplay mechanics, polish and more will be added. As you play the Early Access version, you should expect to encounter unpolished content, bugs and other rough edges as the final product comes together. The base game is free to play, but as an incentive to help out, all premium DLC will be discounted during the Early Access period.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1082220/ss_0abe14697501c78eb465b6b01f1f385cd668a39d.jpg[/img]
[h1]Meet the Cast[/h1]
The story of Outbreak: Epidemic covers three brand new survivors, and the return of Gwen fresh off her horrific nightmare as she searched for her daughter, Hope.

[b]Gwen[/b]'s classes are the survivor and leader. The survivor excels with small arms and has solid damage resistance. The leader trades their own abilities to buff the battle efficiency of their entire team.

[b]Tom[/b] is an ex-marine and sharpshooter. His classes are the Marksman and Adventurer. The Marksman excels with two handed weapons, whereas the Adventurer has buffs towards supporting the team locate equipment.

[b]Kara[/b] is lost the epidemic searching for her sister, Lydia. Her classes are the Reporter and Medic. The reporter has superior self healing and excels with submachine guns. The medic on the other hand trades battle efficiency for the ability to heal the entire team.

Finally, [b]Renault[/b] is the tank. His classes are the Renegade and Lumberjack. The Renegade deals massive damage with Shotguns, whereas the Renegade is a melee powerhouse that leeches health on hit and can use enhanced melee weapons like the Sledgehammer.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1082220/ss_a053e855a869b6ccd9f1c655c12c1070817b33d5.jpg[/img]
[h1]Stay tuned...[/h1]
Stay tuned for the launch of Outbreak: Epidemic and keep involved as we grow the game over the next year as the entire experience is built out. Thanks for your support and we look forward to surviving with you!
